connector.name: Gainium MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Gainium - manage trading bots, deals, and balances via AI assistants
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.gainium.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package gainium-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.gainium, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GAINIUM_PAPER_ONLY
env.description: Set to "true" to restrict the server to paper-trading bots only

env.name: GAINIUM_ALLOWED_BOT_ID
env.description: Optional: restrict all operations to a single bot ID
